integrity: Proof is analytical for every integer n >= 2. The finite exact-arithmetic regression is supporting verification, not a proof for arbitrary n. Publication-priority risk persists; independent scientific validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Complete graphs only; identical payoffs satisfying strict opponent coordination; sequential single-player updates; explicit tie conventions; no guarantee of a bounded number of elapsed activation steps from persistence alone; no extension to heterogeneous payoffs, simultaneous moves, or arbitrary graphs.
title: A sharp switch potential for mixed imitation and best response on complete coordination networks
